tagline: High-value legume and premier edible oil source
hubs: Gujarat, Andhra Pradesh, Rajasthan, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka
descriptionEn: Major oilseed and protein-rich food legume. Outstanding response to Gypsum application (200 kg/acre) at pod pegging.
imageAlt: Harvested freshly uprooted groundnut bunches with healthy tan peanut shells clinging to roots
harvestingIndicator: Leaves turn yellow and shed; inside shell develops blackish net veining.
introTipEn: Apply Agricultural Gypsum at the pegging stage (35–40 DAS) to deliver calcium directly to developing pods and prevent hollow pods.
efficiencyGain: 28% higher pod weight with gypsum & micro-irrigation
micronutrientNote: Zinc and Boron prevent hollow-heart disease inside pods. Apply Borax 4 kg/acre in basal dose.
stagnationAlert: Avoid waterlogging near maturity. Excess soil moisture causes pod blackening and fungal aflatoxin.

fertilizerStages.quantityPerAcre: 25 kg DAP + 20 kg MOP + 100 kg Gypsum
fertilizerStages.applicationMethod: Broad placement in furrows before seeding
Band placement near root zone with light earthing up
Fine mist spraying during cool morning hours

irrigation.frequencyEn: Every 6–8 Days (Maintain friable topsoil during peg entry)
irrigation.criticalStagesEn: Flowering & Pegging (30–50 DAS), Pod Development (60–85 DAS), Pre-Harvest (100+ DAS)
irrigation.tipsEn: Avoid waterlogging near maturity. Excess soil moisture causes pod blackening and fungal aflatoxin.

pestsDiseases.symptomsEn: Dark brown spots with yellow chlorotic halos causing premature defoliation.
pestsDiseases.controlEn: Spray Hexaconazole 5% SC (2 ml/L) or Chlorothalonil 75% WP (2 g/L).

pestsDiseases.symptomsEn: White fungal mycelium at soil level leading to sudden wilting.
pestsDiseases.controlEn: Soil application of Trichoderma viride (2 kg/acre) enriched in farmyard manure.

pestsDiseases.symptomsEn: Root cutting underground leading to dead patches across the field.
pestsDiseases.controlEn: Soil drenching with Chlorpyrifos 20 EC (1.5 L/acre) with first irrigation.

harvestSteps.textEn: Pull sample plants; check for dark inner pericarp veining in >75% of shells.
Uproot when soil is slightly moist. Avoid pulling in dry hard soil to prevent pod loss.
Invert plants under sun for 3–5 days to reduce pod moisture.
Thresh pods when dry and rattle. Expected yield: 12–18 Qtl/acre.
